written.myAnswer: A molecular formula gives the actual number of each type of atom, whereas an empirical formula gives the simplest whole-number ratio. Different molecular formulas can have the same empirical formula; for example, C₆H₆ and C₂H₂ both reduce to CH.
Sand has a giant structure rather than discrete SiO₂ molecules. SiO₂ is its empirical formula, showing the simplest 1:2 ratio of silicon to oxygen atoms.
